name: Tri-Plane NeuS
definition: The baseline model using only tri-planes and MLPs to model the SDF, defined as S(x, y, z) = MLP([T(x, y, z)]).
summary: Tri-Plane NeuS is a neural surface reconstruction method that models the Signed Distance Function using explicit tri-plane features and an MLP to recover high-fidelity 3D surfaces from multi-view images.
